# COMBO_06 · Fire Pillar Slam + Ground Decal Residue (full three-layer stack)

## 1. Search Summary (embedding target)

Fire Pillar Slam + Ground Decal Residue (full three-layer stack). An ultimate-tier staging where a flame pillar strikes the ground and a scorch mark remains. Representative prompt: "Make an effect where a fire pillar strikes down and leaves a decal on the ground". A unified orange (#FF5F13 -> #030000) flame gradient across every layer. Composition: Base FireRise_A / Detail NeutralDecal_A, NeutralFlash_C / Extra FireScatter_C, FireScatter_D. Duration 1.04s. Related vocabulary: fire pillar, flame, fire, slam, ground, decal, scorch, burn mark, residue, aoe, ultimate, meteor, 불기둥, 화염, 불, 낙하, 내리침, 강타, 지면, 바닥, 데칼, 그을음, 자국, 잔흔, 흔적, 광역, 궁극기, 메테오.

- `LoopDuration` **1.04s** — read-only derived value. Cannot be set directly.
  - Determining factor: `FireScatter_C` Delay **0.04 + intrinsic lifetime 1.0 = 1.04s**. The non-integer 1.04 is the decisive evidence that Delay feeds the derivation

## 4. Design Rationale (Why This Combination)

1. The most complete three-layer stack. Impact (Base) -> residual mark (Detail decal) -> debris (Extra), divided along the time axis
2. `NeutralDecal_A` carries the ground mark. A request for something "left on the floor" can only be met by a decal source
3. Extra `FireScatter_C` carries a Delay of 0.04s so it fires marginally after the Base impact — simultaneous fire looks clumped
4. `FireScatter_C` (burst 34, fine debris) and `FireScatter_D` (burst 3, large chunks) together give the debris two size tiers
5. Every layer shares the same color gradient, securing the cohesion of a single element

## 5. Applied Composition Patterns

- `full_three_layer_stack` — Full three-layer stack
- `impact_to_decal_sequence` — Impact -> ground decal residue
- `delay_staggering` — Delay staggering for sequential firing
- `unified_color_theme` — Unified color gradient across all layers

## 7. Adaptation Guide (for the Agent)

- When swapping element, all five layers' Colors must be replaced with the same gradient to preserve cohesion
- Decal persistence is controlled by the tail of the `NeutralDecal_A` Alpha curve. LoopDuration is not something to modify
- Heavier feel: raise Delay from 0.04 to 0.1s and increase `FireScatter_D` Size. LoopDuration will follow automatically from 1.04 to 1.10s
- If the decal is unwanted, removing `NeutralDecal_A` alone leaves the rest intact
